title: Meteoroids Meteors Meteorites
definition: The cosmic continuum of interplanetary rocky debris categorized by its phase and location: **Meteoroids** (in space), **Meteors** (burning through Earth's atmosphere, colloquially called shooting stars), and **Meteorites** (surviving impact on Earth's surface).
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims (GS-1 Geography & Science/Tech) regarding cosmic phenomena, atmospheric layers, and space exploration. Essential for understanding Earth's bombardment history, solar system formation, and asteroid deflection missions.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Meteoroids Meteors Meteorites.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic Astronomy and Solar System Architecture
